article.info_title: Policy update: New Conversion Data Policy
article.info_description:
In the upcoming months, Google Merchant Center will begin tracking more conversion events besides the conversion events attributed to clicks on Shopping free listings, including conversions attributed to clicks on Search web results and other sources. Google Merchant Center has made this change to better report conversion data and optimize the Google shopping experience for your products.

article.info_title: Product Studio country expansion and feature enhancements
article.info_description:
Product Studio has expanded to merchants based in the UK, India, and Japan!
Now, merchants with Merchant Center Next accounts based in the US, UK, CA, AU, IN, and JP can access the suite of free, AI-powered tools to help you create high quality images that you can use across your marketing channels. Get started using Product Studio in Merchant Center Next or within the Google & YouTube app on Shopify.

That’s why we’re continuously improving AI-powered broad match, to help you reach your customers no matter how they’re searching. Advertisers can now use Cross-Media Reach Measurement, a measurement tool in Google Ads, that helps measure deduplicated, on-target reach and frequency across video campaigns.

As a Google Analytics 360 administrator, you can now include Google Marketing Platform (GMP) groups in recipient lists when you send reports by email via the 'Schedule Email' and 'Send Email' share options.

We've enhanced the Advertising section of Google Analytics 4 (GA4). You can now see the number of users who are eligible for remarketing and ads personalization in Google Ads; these are called advertising segments. The GA4 advertising segments are synonymous with audience segments in the Google Ads Audience Manager.

We've updated the default User acquisition and Traffic acquisition reports to include the User key event rate and Session key event rate metrics. If you've included the reports in your report navigation, you will see these key event rate metrics in the reports automatically.

We're coming back to Thailand with Search Central Live! As mentioned in our blog post about our APAC plans for SCL, we now have a date and a site where you can sign up for a chance to secure your spot at Search Central Live Bangkok 2024.
